title: Casefile Revisited: The Frankston Serial Killer

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列，现已上线，您可以在任何收听播客的平台上收听。

sentences.en: As Casefile continues into its 10th year, we're currently taking a very short break from new episodes.
sentences.zh: 随着《Casefile》进入第十个年头，我们目前正在暂停更新新剧集，休息一小段时间。

sentences.en: Brand new cases will be returning on May 23 for premium subscribers and May 30 for the regular feed.
sentences.zh: 全新的案件将于5月23日回归，供高级订阅用户收听，5月30日则在常规频道更新。

sentences.en: But, in the meantime, we're continuing our special bonus series, Casefile Archives, a collection of releases revisiting the earliest years of the show,
sentences.zh: 在此期间，我们将继续播出特别奖励系列《Casefile Archives》，这是一系列回顾节目早期年份的精选内容，

sentences.en: along with previously unreleased premium episodes.
sentences.zh: 以及此前从未发布过的高级订阅剧集。

sentences.en: Over the next three weeks, we'll be releasing two fully re-recorded episodes from our first year of production,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的三周里，我们将发布两集经过全面重新录制的节目，这些内容来自我们制作的第一年，

sentences.en: along with one episode that was previously only available to Patreon and premium subscribers.
sentences.zh: 外加一集此前仅供Patreon和高级订阅用户收听的剧集。

sentences.en: Rest assured that these are additional bonus releases and will not replace our standard schedule.
sentences.zh: 请放心，这些都是额外的奖励内容，不会取代我们的常规更新计划。

sentences.en: We will still be delivering the same number of new episodes this year as we did last year.
sentences.zh: 今年我们依然会像去年一样，保持相同数量的新剧集更新。

sentences.en: Casefile Archives is simply a way to mark the 10th year, revisit some older episodes, and share stories that newer listeners may not have heard before.
sentences.zh: 《Casefile Archives》只是为了纪念节目开播十周年，重温一些旧剧集，并分享一些新听众可能从未听过的故事。

sentences.en: For the re-release episodes, we've fully edited, polished, re-recorded, and freshly produced them from start to finish to match our current production standards.
sentences.zh: 对于这些重新发布的剧集，我们进行了全面的编辑、润色、重新录制，并从头到尾进行了全新的制作，以符合我们当前的制作标准。

sentences.en: They are not complete rewrites.
sentences.zh: 它们并非完全重写。

sentences.en: Our aim isn't to reshape the cases or alter the original storytelling, but to preserve them as they were first told,
sentences.zh: 我们的目的不是重塑案件或改变最初的叙事方式，而是保留它们最初讲述时的样子，

sentences.en: while bringing them up to the level of production the show has today.
sentences.zh: 同时将制作水平提升到节目如今的水准。

sentences.en: Where appropriate, updates have been added, but the core structure remains faithful to the originals.
sentences.zh: 在适当的情况下，我们添加了更新内容，但核心结构依然忠实于原版。

sentences.en: Because of this, these episodes may sound a little different to our recent work.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，这些剧集听起来可能与我们近期的作品略有不同。

sentences.en: Today's re-release is The Frankston Serial Killer, originally released as Case 23 in June 2016.
sentences.zh: 今天重新发布的是《弗兰克斯顿连环杀手》，最初作为第23案于2016年6月发布。

sentences.en: The case was first presented as a two-part series, with part one released on June 19, followed by part two the following week.
sentences.zh: 该案最初是以两集系列的形式呈现的，第一部分于6月19日发布，第二部分则在接下来的一周发布。

sentences.en: Thank you to everyone who has listened and supported us over the years.
sentences.zh: 感谢多年来一直收听并支持我们的每一位听众。

sentences.en: Now, here is the next episode from Casefile Archives,
sentences.zh: 现在，请收听《Casefile Archives》的下一集，

sentences.en: The Frankston Serial Killer.
sentences.zh: 《弗兰克斯顿连环杀手》。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严肃且往往令人不安的事件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果您在任何时候感到需要支持，请联系您当地的危机中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support, and for a more detailed list of content warnings, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 如需获取保密支持的建议电话号码，以及更详细的内容警告列表，请查看您应用中或我们网站上本集的节目说明。

sentences.en: This episode contains descriptions of animal cruelty.
sentences.zh: 本集包含对虐待动物行为的描述。

sentences.en: Frankston City is a local government area in Victoria, located 40 kilometres south-east of Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克斯顿市是维多利亚州的一个地方政府区域，位于墨尔本东南40公里处。

sentences.en: At the time of this episode's initial release, it had a population of about 135,000 people.
sentences.zh: 在本集最初发布时，该市人口约为13.5万人。

sentences.en: Frankston City incorporates many different suburbs, including Frankston, Langwarren, Frankston North, Seaford, and others.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克斯顿市包含许多不同的郊区，包括弗兰克斯顿、朗沃伦、北弗兰克斯顿、西福德等地。

sentences.en: All of the places you will hear about in this episode are part of the Frankston City area.
sentences.zh: 您在本集中听到的所有地点都属于弗兰克斯顿市区域。

sentences.en: Our story begins in February 1993 on Claude Street in Seaford, where a local resident by the name of Donna Vaines was growing nervous.
sentences.zh: 我们的故事始于1993年2月，地点在西福德的克劳德街，当地居民唐娜·韦恩斯当时感到有些不安。

sentences.en: She lived in a unit there with her boyfriend,
sentences.zh: 她和男友住在那里的一套公寓里，

sentences.en: Les, and her young infant, but lately, Donna's home life had been disrupted by a series of prank phone calls.
sentences.zh: 还有她年幼的孩子。但最近，唐娜的家庭生活被一系列恶作剧电话搅得不得安宁。

sentences.en: Les worked as a pizza delivery driver, meaning he was typically out at night, leaving Donna home alone with the baby.
sentences.zh: 莱斯是一名披萨外送员，这意味着他通常晚上不在家，留下唐娜独自带着孩子。

sentences.en: Feeling uncomfortable due to the calls she had been receiving,
sentences.zh: 由于一直接到这些电话，唐娜感到很不舒服，

sentences.en: Donna decided to spend one particular February evening driving around with Les while he worked, rather than stay home alone.
sentences.zh: 于是她决定在2月的一个晚上，与其独自待在家里，不如开车陪莱斯一起去送外卖。

sentences.en: As it happened,
sentences.zh: 巧合的是，

sentences.en: Les only had a short shift that night, so they were back home within about an hour.
sentences.zh: 莱斯那天晚上的班次很短，所以他们不到一小时就回到了家。

sentences.en: The first thing they saw when they walked inside was Donna's cat on the lounge room floor, dead.
sentences.zh: 他们进门后看到的第一件事，就是唐娜的猫死在客厅地板上。

sentences.en: A picture of a naked woman had been placed on top of the cat, and written on a wall in the cat's blood were the words,
sentences.zh: 猫的身上放着一张裸女的照片，墙上用猫血写着一行字：

sentences.en: Donna, you're dead.
sentences.zh: “唐娜，你死定了。”

sentences.en: There were further horrific discoveries elsewhere in the unit.
sentences.zh: 公寓的其他地方还有更可怕的发现。

sentences.en: The entire place had been ransacked, drawers were pulled out, cupboards had been opened, and Donna's belongings were strewn everywhere.
sentences.zh: 整个房间被翻得乱七八糟，抽屉被拉开，橱柜被打开，唐娜的私人物品散落一地。

sentences.en: A knife had been used to slash and stab the walls and cabinets.
sentences.zh: 墙壁和橱柜上被刀划得伤痕累累。

sentences.en: The intruder had even done this in the nursery, slashing some of the baby's clothes.
sentences.zh: 入侵者甚至在婴儿房里也做了同样的事，划破了孩子的一些衣服。

sentences.en: In the crib was another picture of a naked woman, stabbed through with a knife so viciously, it cut through to the crib below.
sentences.zh: 婴儿床里放着另一张裸女照片，被一把刀狠狠地刺穿，力道之大，连下面的婴儿床垫都被扎透了。

sentences.en: In the bathroom,
sentences.zh: 在浴室里，

sentences.en: Donna's two kittens lay dead, both violently killed.
sentences.zh: 唐娜的两只小猫躺在地上，都已经惨死。

sentences.en: Shaving cream had been used to write the names
sentences.zh: 有人用剃须膏在浴室镜子上写下了名字：

sentences.en: Donna and Robin on the bathroom mirror.
sentences.zh: “唐娜”和“罗宾”。

sentences.en: This message baffled Donna, as she didn't know anybody named Robin.
sentences.zh: 这个信息让唐娜感到困惑，因为她根本不认识叫罗宾的人。

sentences.en: Nor could she think of anybody who would so violently damage her home or harm her pets.
sentences.zh: 她也想不出有谁会如此暴力地破坏她的家或伤害她的宠物。

sentences.en: Les wasn't her child's father, but the breakup with her ex-partner hadn't been that bad.
sentences.zh: 莱斯不是她孩子的父亲，但她与前任的分手并没有闹得那么僵。

sentences.en: He'd never been violent towards her during the relationship, and she couldn't believe he would start now.
sentences.zh: 在恋爱期间，他从未对她施暴，她无法相信他现在会做出这种事。

sentences.en: Police later questioned her ex and learned he had a solid alibi.
sentences.zh: 警方后来询问了她的前任，得知他有确凿的不在场证明。

sentences.en: Terrified,
sentences.zh: 惊恐万分的

sentences.en: Donna left her unit immediately and moved in with her sister,
sentences.zh: 唐娜立即离开了公寓，搬去和她的姐姐住在一起，

sentences.en: Trisha Vaines.
sentences.zh: 特里莎·韦恩斯。

sentences.en: Trisha's neighbour,
sentences.zh: 特里莎的邻居，

sentences.en: Julia, comforted Donna.
sentences.zh: 朱莉娅，安慰了唐娜。

sentences.en: She could empathise because she had just experienced a similar thing.
sentences.zh: 她对此感同身受，因为她刚刚也经历了类似的事情。

sentences.en: When Julia was recently away for a holiday, somebody had broken into her unit and slashed every photo that featured her across her throat.
sentences.zh: 当朱莉娅最近去度假时，有人闯入她的公寓，把所有照片中她本人的喉咙部位都划破了。

sentences.en: The dress she'd worn to her engagement party was cut up as well.
sentences.zh: 她订婚派对上穿的那件礼服也被剪碎了。

sentences.en: Just like Donna,
sentences.zh: 就像唐娜一样，

sentences.en: Julia had no enemies and couldn't imagine who would be capable of such a thing.
sentences.zh: 朱莉娅没有敌人，也无法想象谁会做出这种事。

sentences.en: A young man who lived next door to Trisha reassured the two women that whoever was responsible was just a sicko and he would look out for them.
sentences.zh: 住在特里莎隔壁的一名年轻男子向这两位女性保证，无论谁是肇事者，都只是个变态，他会帮她们留意。

sentences.en: It wouldn't have seemed like it at the time, but in the coming months,
sentences.zh: 当时看起来似乎没什么，但在接下来的几个月里，

sentences.en: Donna and Julia would learn how incredibly lucky they'd been.
sentences.zh: 唐娜和朱莉娅会意识到她们是多么幸运。

sentences.en: Tasmanian local
sentences.zh: 塔斯马尼亚当地人

sentences.en: Elizabeth Stevens had been living in foster care since she was 14.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·史蒂文斯从14岁起就一直住在寄养家庭中。

sentences.en: After she turned 18, she decided to relocate to Victoria to move in with her auntie Rita and Uncle Paul, arriving in January 1993.
sentences.zh: 18岁后，她决定搬到维多利亚州，与她的姨妈丽塔和姨父保罗同住，并于1993年1月抵达。

sentences.en: They lived together in Patterson Avenue in the suburb of Langwarren.
sentences.zh: 他们一起住在朗沃伦郊区的帕特森大道。

sentences.en: Although Elizabeth was quiet and shy, she was also extremely friendly to anyone she met.
sentences.zh: 虽然伊丽莎白安静害羞，但她对遇到的每个人都非常友好。

sentences.en: She was studying at TAFE in Frankston.
sentences.zh: 她在弗兰克斯顿的TAFE（职业技术学院）学习。

sentences.en: For those not familiar with TAFE, it is similar to community or technical college in other parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 对于那些不熟悉TAFE的人来说，它类似于世界其他地方的社区学院或技术学院。

sentences.en: As Elizabeth had grown up in Tasmania, she didn't have many friends in the Frankston area and no boyfriends.
sentences.zh: 由于伊丽莎白是在塔斯马尼亚长大的，她在弗兰克斯顿地区没什么朋友，也没有男朋友。

sentences.en: When she wasn't studying, she liked to spend her time reading and mainly hung out at home.
sentences.zh: 不学习的时候，她喜欢看书，大部分时间都待在家里。

sentences.en: On Friday,
sentences.zh: 在周五，

sentences.en: June 11,
1993, four months after Donna Vane's violent break-in,
sentences.zh: 1993年，在唐娜·韦恩斯遭遇暴力入室抢劫四个月后，

sentences.en: Paul and Rita arrived home from work to find a note from Elizabeth on the kitchen bench.
sentences.zh: 保罗和丽塔下班回家，发现厨房桌台上留着伊丽莎白的一张字条。

sentences.en: The note explained that she had gone to the TAFE library to study and would be back about 8pm.
sentences.zh: 字条上写着她去了TAFE图书馆学习，大约晚上8点回来。

sentences.en: Elizabeth always made sure to let Paul and Rita know where she was, so when it ticked over to 10pm and Elizabeth still wasn't home,
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白总是确保让保罗和丽塔知道她的去向，所以当时间过了晚上10点，伊丽莎白还没回家时，

sentences.en: Paul and Rita panicked.
sentences.zh: 保罗和丽塔慌了神。

sentences.en: Paul got in his car and started driving around the streets looking for his niece.
sentences.zh: 保罗上了车，开始在街上四处寻找他的侄女。

sentences.en: Elizabeth didn't drive so she caught the bus to and from TAFE.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白不会开车，所以她往返TAFE都是坐公交车。

sentences.en: Paul drove to Frankston TAFE then back to
sentences.zh: 保罗开车去了弗兰克斯顿TAFE，然后回到

sentences.en: Cranbourne Road,
sentences.zh: 克兰伯恩路，

sentences.en: Lake Warren where Elizabeth's bus stop was located.
sentences.zh: 也就是伊丽莎白下车的公交站所在的朗沃伦。

sentences.en: It was only a short walk from the bus stop to Paul and Rita's house.
sentences.zh: 从公交车站到保罗和丽塔家只有很短的路程。

sentences.en: Paul took the same route as the bus before expanding his search into surrounding streets.
sentences.zh: 保罗沿着公交车的路线走了一遍，然后扩大了搜索范围，进入了周围的街道。

sentences.en: He couldn't find any trace of Elizabeth.
sentences.zh: 他找不到伊丽莎白的任何踪迹。

sentences.en: The weather didn't help.
sentences.zh: 天气状况也不帮忙。

sentences.en: Heavy rain and gusts of wind significantly reduced
sentences.zh: 大雨和阵风严重降低了

sentences.en: Paul's visibility.
sentences.zh: 保罗的视线。

sentences.en: The couple called the police who arrived just after 1am.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇报了警，警察在凌晨1点多赶到。

sentences.en: The officer who attended,
sentences.zh: 负责此案的警官，

sentences.en: Sergeant Webster, immediately had a feeling something wasn't right.
sentences.zh: 韦伯斯特警长，立刻感觉到有些不对劲。

sentences.en: There were the missing person reports where a young person had a lot of friends, liked to go out partying, took off with boyfriend or girlfriend, or had trouble at home.
sentences.zh: 有些失踪人口报告是年轻人朋友多、喜欢出去聚会、跟男女朋友私奔，或者家里有矛盾。

sentences.en: Then there were the missing person reports that were completely out of character.
sentences.zh: 但还有些失踪人口报告完全不符合当事人的性格。

sentences.en: Elizabeth was reliable, well behaved and left a note letting her auntie and uncle know exactly where she was and when she'd be home.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白可靠、行为端正，还留了字条告诉姨妈和姨父她确切的去向和回家时间。

sentences.en: She didn't have a boyfriend or many friends at all and she wasn't the partying type.
sentences.zh: 她没有男朋友，也没什么朋友，也不是那种喜欢聚会的人。

sentences.en: The police conducted their own search though there wasn't much they could do at that time of morning.
sentences.zh: 警方进行了自己的搜寻，尽管在那个时间点他们能做的不多。

sentences.en: The TAFE and library were shut and the bus company had finished up for the night.
sentences.zh: TAFE和图书馆都关门了，公交公司也已经结束了当天的运营。

sentences.en: There was nobody to go and question.
sentences.zh: 没有人可以去询问。

sentences.en: After they looked for Elizabeth without success, they made a report and left instructions for their day shift colleagues to follow up.
sentences.zh: 在搜寻伊丽莎白无果后，他们做了记录，并指示白班同事跟进。

sentences.en: The next day, a local man named Rod was down at Lloyd Park on Cranbourne
sentences.zh: 第二天，一名叫罗德的当地人在克兰伯恩的劳埃德公园，

sentences.en: Frankston Road in Langwarren.
sentences.zh: 位于朗沃伦的弗兰克斯顿路附近。

sentences.en: Lloyd Park is a large area surrounded by scrub and trees with playgrounds, barbecue facilities, a couple of sporting fields and vast grassy areas.
sentences.zh: 劳埃德公园是一个很大的区域，周围环绕着灌木丛和树木，有游乐场、烧烤设施、几个运动场和广阔的草地。

sentences.en: At night, it is a very quiet and isolated spot.
sentences.zh: 晚上，这里是一个非常安静且偏僻的地方。

sentences.en: Rod's wife had sent him to Lloyd Park to find a small pine tree they could decorate for their mid-year
sentences.zh: 罗德的妻子让他去劳埃德公园找一棵小松树，好让他们装饰一下年中

sentences.en: Christmas party.
sentences.zh: 圣诞派对。

sentences.en: Rod walked along one of the tracks that weaved through the trees and scrub searching for a suitable tree.
sentences.zh: 罗德沿着穿过树木和灌木丛的一条小路走，寻找合适的树。

sentences.en: Instead, he discovered the body of Elizabeth Stevens.
sentences.zh: 结果，他发现了伊丽莎白·史蒂文斯的遗体。

sentences.en: Police were called and set up a crime scene.
sentences.zh: 警方接到报警后，封锁了犯罪现场。

sentences.en: Elizabeth had been the victim of a frenzied knife attack.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白是一场疯狂刀刺袭击的受害者。

sentences.en: Multiple stab wounds and a crisscross pattern had been carved into her stomach.
sentences.zh: 她身上有多处刀伤，腹部被刻上了十字交叉的图案。

sentences.en: The killer had also stomped on her face, breaking her nose.
sentences.zh: 凶手还踩踏了她的脸，导致鼻梁骨折。

sentences.en: A post-mortem would reveal that Elizabeth was choked unconscious prior to being stabbed.
sentences.zh: 尸检显示，伊丽莎白在被刺之前曾被掐晕。

sentences.en: Although her top had been removed, the bottom half of her clothing was intact.
sentences.zh: 虽然她的上衣被脱掉了，但下半身的衣服完好无损。

sentences.en: There was no evidence of sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 没有证据表明她曾遭受性侵。

sentences.en: Lloyd Park was only a short walk from
sentences.zh: 劳埃德公园距离

sentences.en: He argued that the sentencing judge should have given him a minimum term of imprisonment.

sentences.zh: 三名法官以二比一的多数裁决，推翻了初审法官不设定最低刑期的决定。

sentences.en: They granted Paul Denia a non-parole period of 30 years, meaning he could have been released in 2023, when he was 51 years old.
sentences.zh: 他们给予保罗·丹尼亚30年的不得假释期，这意味着他本可以在2023年，即他51岁时获释。

sentences.en: When given this minimum term, Denia said, I will become a better person and I will not re-offend.
sentences.zh: 当被告知这个最低刑期时，丹尼亚说：我会成为一个更好的人，我不会再犯。

sentences.en: While in prison, Denia began saying that he now identified as a woman and began going by the name Paula instead of Paul.
sentences.zh: 在狱中，丹尼亚开始说他现在认同自己为女性，并开始使用“宝拉”这个名字，而不是保罗。

sentences.en: He claimed that his gender dysphoria had led him to hate women and ultimately resulted in him committing crimes against them.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己的性别焦虑导致他仇恨女性，并最终导致他犯下了针对女性的罪行。

sentences.en: He applied to have access to makeup and other beauty products, as well as hormone therapy and gender reassignment surgery.
sentences.zh: 他申请使用化妆品和其他美容产品，以及接受激素治疗和性别重置手术。

sentences.en: All of those requests were denied.
sentences.zh: 所有这些请求都被拒绝了。

sentences.en: Prison authorities, victims' families and transgender advocates have all expressed doubts
sentences.zh: 监狱当局、受害者家属和跨性别权益倡导者都对丹尼亚声称的真实性表示怀疑。

sentences.en: about the sincerity of Denia's claiMs. One prison officer said Denia's supposed transition was sudden and merely a ruse to gain access to certain benefits.
sentences.zh: 一位监狱官员说，丹尼亚所谓的转变是突然的，仅仅是为了获得某些福利而耍的手段。

sentences.en: By 2022, Denia had reverted back to using the name Paul and identifying as male.

sentences.en: That same year, Paul Denia became eligible for parole.
sentences.zh: 同年，保罗·丹尼亚获得了假释资格。

sentences.en: Russell's father, Brian, received the news, he felt a sense of relief, telling the ABC, it was a terrific outcome as far as I'm concerned.
sentences.zh: 拉塞尔的父亲布莱恩在得知这一消息时感到如释重负，他告诉美国广播公司，就我而言，这是一个极好的结果。

sentences.en: Debbie Freem's son, Jake, who was just 12 days old when his mother was murdered, told The Age newspaper that Denia was not someone who should ever be released.
sentences.zh: 黛比·弗里姆的儿子杰克在母亲遇害时年仅12天大，他告诉《时代报》，德尼亚绝不应该被释放。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用如下：

sentences.en: He has done nothing to deserve it.
sentences.zh: 他所做的一切不值得被宽恕。

sentences.en: He will never change, and they must keep him inside.
sentences.zh: 他永远不会改变，他们必须把他关在里面。

sentences.en: Despite his initial parole application being rejected, Denia remained eligible to apply again and again.
sentences.zh: 尽管他最初的假释申请被驳回，但德尼亚仍有资格一次又一次地提出申请。

sentences.en: Each time, the victim's families would be forced to prepare submissions, relive the trauma, and face the possibility that he could one day be released.
sentences.zh: 每一次，受害者家属都被迫准备陈述材料，重温创伤，并面对他有朝一日可能被释放的可能性。

sentences.en: In direct response, the Victorian government passed new laws in late 2023, allowing the parole board to impose a no-return date for
sentences.zh: 作为直接回应，维多利亚州政府在2023年底通过了新法律，允许假释委员会对

sentences.zh: 包括德尼亚在内的某些终身监禁囚犯设定不得假释期。

sentences.en: The laws were developed in consultation with the family of Natalie Russell, Denia's final victim, and were dubbed Nat's Law.
sentences.zh: 这些法律是在与德尼亚的最后一名受害者娜塔莉·拉塞尔的家人协商后制定的，被称为“娜塔莉法”。

sentences.en: It's like having a tremendous weight lifted off us, Brian Russell told the ABC.
sentences.zh: 这就像卸下了我们身上的一块巨石，布莱恩·拉塞尔告诉美国广播公司。

sentences.en: We're tickled pink knowing that Denia will never be allowed to apply for parole again and there's no hope of him ever getting out of jail.
sentences.zh: 得知德尼亚再也不能申请假释，而且他永远没有希望出狱，我们感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: It's something we've been working towards for the last 30 years.
sentences.zh: 这是我们过去30年来一直努力争取的目标。

sentences.en: When this started, Denia was knocked back on parole, but six months down the track, he could have applied again and we'd have to go through it all once more.
sentences.zh: 当这一切开始时，德尼亚的假释申请被驳回了，但六个月后，他本可以再次申请，而我们又得重新经历这一切。

sentences.en: Now, that will never happen, and it won't happen in other cases either.
sentences.zh: 现在，这种情况永远不会再发生了，在其他案件中也不会发生。

sentences.en: The loss of Natalie is something we live with every day.
sentences.zh: 失去娜塔莉是我们每天都要面对的事实。

sentences.en: We don't need the added pressure of knowing her murderer could be free at any time.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要再承受那种担心杀害她的凶手随时可能重获自由的额外压力。
